item.description:
### Added
- DeepSnap speaks 11 languages: English, Українська, Русский, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Português (Brasil) and 简体中文 — with the system, or chosen in Settings › General.
- Onboarding shows what DeepSnap does: capture and markup, recording, secrets and faces, text from the screen, history, guides and Markdown — with their shortcuts.
- DeepSnap Help (Help › DeepSnap Help, ⌘?, or the menu bar menu): every feature with screenshots, your shortcuts and the keys of the editor, thumbnails, pins and recording, GIFs of clicks, keys pressed and the camera in a recording, and Free and Pro side by side with Buy — searchable, in all 11 languages, without the internet. - About DeepSnap in the menu bar menu too: version, copyright and a link to DeepSnap's page. - When a full menu bar hides DeepSnap's icon (or the notch covers it), DeepSnap shows itself in the Dock until the icon is back: the Dock icon opens its menu, and ⌘, and ⌘? work. A note says so the first time.
- DeepSnap installs with Homebrew: `brew install --cask deeplabua/tap/deepsnap`.
### Fixed
- Keys pressed in a recording shows shortcuts another app has taken (⌃⇧Space) and keys typed into DeepSnap. - The update window opens in the middle of the screen.
